notes.title: Devlog 06/2025
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone! It’s time for another short but sweet devlog – not quite monthly (as I previously hoped), but hopefully a nice little overview of what we’ve been up to and what's to come. 😊[/p][p][/p][p][b]Quick note:[/b] If you want a chance to test [i]Rootbound[/i] soon, you’ll definitely want to keep reading! 😉[/p][p][/p][p]What's in this devlog:[/p][list][*][p]A brand-new gameplay trailer![/p][/*][*][p]Packy comes to life![/p][/*][*][p]Wishlist numbers[/p][/*][*][p]Meet us at Gamescom![/p][/*][*][p]Want to test the game?[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="1ztfA2yr4fY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Most of you have probably already seen it – we recently released a brand-new [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1ztfA2yr4fY"]gameplay trailer[/url]! It was first shown exclusively as part of the [i]German Indie Showcase[/i] hosted by Gronkh and PhunkRoyal, and shortly after, we published it on YouTube.[/p][p]And what can we say – we’re absolutely thrilled by the response and the sheer number of views it’s received. As of now, the trailer has been watched over [b]50,000 times[/b] – absolutely amazing! We’re beyond excited and grateful for everyone who discovered our game through the trailer.[/p][p]If you haven’t seen it yet, go check it out and don’t forget to leave a like! 😊[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Packy is coming to life![/b][/h3][p]When we first announced [i]Rootbound[/i], we shared that your backpack would be a living companion. Back in March, though, there wasn’t much of that actually in the game yet. But now, things are finally starting to take shape![/p][p]Our Packy – the working name for our adorable backpack buddy – already has some traits that make her feel much more alive. Some are helpful for players – like catching and storing items thrown at her. Others might cause a bit of trouble – for example, when Packy flat-out refuses to hold certain items.[/p][p]Rumor has it, she might even get grumpy if you keep feeding her nasty stuff...
[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534013/ed8a594b950414b0cb1c39cfa04bad251ef366c2.gif"][/img][/p][p]We’re still in the early stages with Packy and have lots of ideas on how to give her more personality. Got your own ideas? Join our Discord and share them with us – who knows, maybe your suggestion will make it into the game! 😉[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Wishlists[/b][/h3][p]For those who love numbers – here’s a little update on our wishlist stats. Our new trailer brought a big boost in recent days, and we’re now sitting at [b]16,500 wishlists[/b]![/p][p]We’re super proud of how far we’ve come and incredibly thankful for all your support! 😊[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Meet us at Gamescom![/b][/h3][p]Want to meet us in person? You’ll have your chance this August! We’ll be at [b]Gamescom[/b] and would love to say hi![/p][p]We’ll share more details about where and when to find us closer to the end of July. There might even be a chance to catch a sneak peek at [i]Rootbound[/i] there! 👀[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Looking for Testers![/b][/h3][p]As hinted in our last devlog, we’re in the final stages of preparing a [b]demo[/b], and we want to give a few of you the chance to [b]test it early[/b] and share your feedback![/p][p]Interested in testing [i]Rootbound[/i]? Join our [url="https://discord.gg/8AMyV6fEmX"]Discord[/url], and we’ll post all the details there as soon as we’re ready. It won’t be much longer now![/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Wrapping up[/b][/h3][p]And finally, the obligatory call to action! Got questions or requests? Want to know more about us or specific parts of the [i]Rootbound[/i] development? Don’t be shy – reach out! You can contact us in all sorts of ways:[/p][p][/p][p]🌍 Website:[/p][p][url="https://www.brainlag-games.com/"]https://www.brainlag-games.com/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]🎮 Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/8AMyV6fEmX"][u]Rootbound [/u][/url][/p][p]🐦 Twitter: [url="https://twitter.com/brainlaggames"][u]brainlaggames[/u][/url][/p][p]🧵 Threads: [url="https://www.threads.net/@brainlaggames"][u]@brainlaggames[/u][/url][/p][p]📸 Instagram: [url="https://www.instagram.com/brainlaggames"][u]brainlaggames  [/u][/url][/p][p]🎵 TikTok: [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@brainlaggames"][u]brainlaggames[/u][/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all – and see you next time![/p][p]Markus[/p]

notes.title: Devlog March 2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534013/0c40def1c07dc779487adf047d8cd8d16cc581a7.png[/img]

[h1]Devlog März/March 2025[/h1]

Hey everyone! Welcome to our very first devlog – the first of (hopefully) monthly insights into the development of Rootbound and our inner workings!

If you have any questions about this or just want to chat, feel free to drop by our Discord!
[url=https://discord.gg/8AMyV6fEmX]Rootbound Discord[/url]

[b]What to expect here:[/b]
[list]
[*] Announcement preparations
[*] How did we experience the announcement?
[*] Wishlist numbers
[*] Trailer Scoring Competition
[*] What’s next?
[/list]

You can imagine March was a pretty special month for us. After many months of working on Rootbound, we were finally able to not only show you what we’re working on – but also show you that we’re working at all! With Brainlag Games, we’re taking an entirely new path, and we couldn’t be more excited about what the future holds. After the end of Piranha Bytes, it quickly became clear to us that we weren’t done with the games industry just yet. Of course, we see the current state of the industry – with layoffs and studio closures – but we also see an opportunity in that! We’re convinced there’s no better time to kick off as a new team. And your support has confirmed that more than we ever hoped for!

[h2]Trailer Work and Announcement Preparations[/h2]

But first, let’s take a step back and look at the beginning of the year. In order to properly present Rootbound, a few preparations were necessary. We knew right away we wanted to have a trailer for our announcement. But what sounds like a small task came with quite a few challenges. First off, none of us had done much video editing in recent years – so we had a lot to learn.

But even more important were the actual gameplay scenes. What exactly did we want to show you? What story did we want to tell? And where would we get the music from? Amadeus already went into detail about the challenges we faced while recording the trailer in a great [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nz4IogH20cA&t=65s]video[/url].

It was a ton of work, but we’re really happy with how it turned out. If you haven’t seen the announcement trailer yet, make sure to check it out [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1-n_GAzb7Gc]here[/url]! What did you think? Would you have done anything differently? We’re always open to honest feedback!

[h2]Announcement and Developer Interview[/h2]

Our announcement was accompanied by quite a bit of media buzz. Having been an enthusiastic Gamestar reader in my youth, seeing our own game as a headline on the Gamestar website was something truly special. But Gamestar was far from the only website that reported on us. We were completely overwhelmed by the number of articles from around the world and couldn’t even keep up with reading all the posts and comments. A huge thank-you to all of you for your kind and honest words!

I’d also like to highlight our developer interview. Daniel and Michael from the heise team visited us and recorded a lovely [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AIakVfhsPbk]video interview[/url] (German). The video was accompanied by a very detailed German [url=https://www.heise.de/hintergrund/Nach-der-Entlassung-Ehemalige-Gothic-Entwickler-gruenden-ihre-eigene-Firma-9958100.html]article [/url](unfortunately behind a paywall), in which Daniel summarized our development journey so far, and talked about stumbling blocks but also opportunities in the form of funding. Definitely worth a read for anyone thinking about stepping into the games industry themselves!

[h2]Wishlists[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534013/8b6690b5e71c110f120bc48b85a3b5f6f741812e.gif[/img]

Let’s talk hard numbers. Steam wishlists are especially important for smaller indie studios, as they allow us to roughly estimate a game’s future sales potential. Now, just about four weeks after our announcement, we’ve already hit an incredible 9047 wishlists – from over 100 countries! Amazing numbers we definitely didn’t expect. Huge thanks to every single one of you for the support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534013/64d03044072e2a88c90abb3b633c48ebf067c73d.png[/img]

[h2]Rootbound Trailer Scoring Competition[/h2]

To wrap things up, I want to shine a light on the currently ongoing [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLHGGGs1CPT0Tj0-pPBBaLKrf-P2gNzP5M]Rootbound Trailer Scoring Competition[/url] by Marika Schanz and Martin Heidenreich. Marika is the composer for our trailer and did an amazing job. You can still take part until April 12th – and yes, there’s something to win. Join in and give our trailer your own unique twist! You’ll find more info about the competition [url=https://www.marikaschanz.com/rootboundscoringcontest]here[/url].

Once the submission deadline has passed, we’ll sit down with Marika and Martin to choose the winners. We’re really excited to hear your pieces and can’t wait to dive into the entries!

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534013/c38866bcec35d621848857e57822d90a69063d39.gif[/img]

The next few weeks for us are all about gameplay. So that we can soon share more of our game vision with you, we’re currently working hard on a playable demo, which we’ll first have tested by friends and acquaintances. In the next devlog, we’ll dive deeper into our gameplay ideas and give you a better look at what makes Rootbound special.

[h2]Closing Words[/h2]

What else is there to say except: Thank you so much for your support and for being interested in what we’re doing. Do you have any wishes or requests for us? Would you like to learn more about us or specific parts of Rootbound’s development? Don’t be shy – just contact us! You can reach us in many different ways:

🌍 Website: [url=https://www.brainlag-games.com/]https://www.brainlag-games.com/[/url]
🐦 Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/brainlaggames]brainlaggames[/url]
🧵 Threads: [url=https://www.threads.net/@brainlaggames]@brainlaggames[/url]
📸 Instagram: [url=https://www.instagram.com/brainlaggames]brainlaggames [/url] 
🎵 TikTok: [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@brainlaggames]brainlaggames[/url]
🎮 Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/8AMyV6fEmX]Rootbound [/url]

That’s all from us for now! But wait: I wanted to leave one more little thing right here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534013/0c07414c3c751b1d43bce77548c83633b88ba0d9.jpg[/img]

What would a devlog from me be without a cat photo! 🙂

Much love to you all,
Markus
